description: This file contains functions and classes for packaging and loading PyTorch artifacts into a custom archive format (.pt2). It includes utilities for serializing models, constants, weights, and related metadata, as well as classes for reading and writing archive files. The code is specific to the torch.export.pt2_archive module and handles complex serialization/deserialization workflows for model deployment.

classes.name: PT2ArchiveWriter
classes.description: Context manager class for writing a PT2 archive, providing methods to write bytes, strings, files, folders, and manage archive records.

classes.name: PT2ArchiveReader
classes.description: Context manager class for reading a PT2 archive, providing methods to read bytes, strings, and retrieve archive metadata.

classes.name: AOTICompiledModel
classes.description: A class representing a loaded AOT Inductor model from a .pt2 archive, allowing invocation, metadata retrieval, and constants loading.

classes.name: PT2ArchiveContents
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the contents of a loaded PT2 archive, including exported programs, AOTI runners, and extra files.

methods.name: is_pt2_package
methods.description: Checks if the given serialized model bytes or file is a valid PT2 archive package.

methods.name: package_pt2
methods.description: Serializes and saves models, constants, weights, and related data into a PT2 archive format.

methods.name: load_pt2
methods.description: Loads and deserializes a PT2 archive, reconstructing models, constants, weights, and metadata.

methods.name: load_weights_to_pt2_contents
methods.description: Loads weights into the models contained within a PT2ArchiveContents object.
